key_concepts: Atoms contain three subatomic particles: protons, neutrons, and electrons
Protons and neutrons are located in the nucleus
Electrons are located outside the nucleus
Atomic number equals the number of protons
In a neutral atom, the number of protons equals the number of electrons
Atomic mass equals the sum of protons and neutrons
Ions form by gaining or losing electrons; cations have more protons than electrons and ani
Periodic table symbols give atomic number and atomic mass, which are used to determine sub
